parameters.query:
WITH gate AS (
  SELECT governance.acquire_runtime_gate('agent_reporting') AS reliability_gate
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN (reliability_gate->>'allowed')::boolean
    THEN governance.execute_agent_metric_request($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb)
  ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'status','rejected',
    'reason','CIRCUIT_OPEN',
    'retry_after',reliability_gate->>'retry_after'
  )
END AS agent_result
FROM gate;
